svg.title: style-tile
svg.text: 静读 / Margin — one essay, an unhurried decision · Generated specification; product styles resolve TOKENS.json
Identity in combination — same tokens and anatomy as the sheets
把注意力交还给一篇文章
Why: J-02: one concentrated accent commits to one essay; modest corners distinguish a control from the uncontained article. Content: Use conci
se task labels; preserve full article titles rather than ellipsizing the primary decision.
Why: J-06: saving is reversible and visually secondary; it must not compete with the reading CTA. Content: Use concise task labels; preserve f
ull article titles rather than ellipsizing the primary decision.
Why: J-05: whitespace contains editorial content; a border would imply an unrelated clickable card. Content: Use concise task labels; preserve
full article titles rather than ellipsizing the primary decision.
用十二分钟，重新观察每天经过的街道。
Why: J-06: a visible input boundary distinguishes editing from reading. Content: Use concise task labels; preserve full article titles rather
hover excluded: Focus defines editing; hover adds no separate meaning to this text field.
Why: J-10: native links preserve browser navigation and remain subordinate to the essay title. Content: Use concise task labels; preserve full
article titles rather than ellipsizing the primary decision.
hover excluded: Underline native links on hover; no separate surface treatment is needed.
Why: J-07: a small rectangular selection field is sufficient; pill containers would overemphasize filters. Content: Use concise task labels; p
reserve full article titles rather than ellipsizing the primary decision.
hover excluded: Text underline conveys pointer affordance without adding an accent.
Why: J-09: feedback explains state while leaving the reading column stable. Content: Use concise task labels; preserve full article titles rat
her than ellipsizing the primary decision.
已保存，下次从这里继续。
保存失败。文章仍在，请重试。

selected omitted: This is an action, not a persistent selection; active feedback applies instead.
Deliberate image absence: This text-led product reduces selection pressure through the article title and synopsis. Decorative photos
would compete with reading; fallback remains a readable essay.
Spacing scale — lengths at 1 SVG unit per token unit
Radius roles — same rectangle, different corner relationship
Motion cue — conceptual state diagram, not timing proof
Read → reading position retained → Saved. Proposed feedback uses motion.feedback; navigation uses motion.transition. Reduced motion
updates labels immediately; no looping decoration.
